scope: Runtime overlay, using the previously qualified compiler runtime for unchanged dependencies.
behavior: The creating worker can exit before the first call on another thread.
An active reader retains the payload across logical close. New reads are rejected.
Two workers can compete to close while the destructor is active; the payload is consumed exactly once.
A failed destructor can be retried on a different worker. An unclosed leaf can also retire on a worker final release.
Existing creator-affine code continuation, deferred retirement and typed NativeSequence result/rollback checks still pass.
